main_text.head: VERSVS II.

p.i: Surge,& uade in Niniueh ciuitatem il-Lectio 43.
lam magnam,& prædica in ea prædicatio14. Martijnem quam loquor ad te.

main_text.p: Hic uersus præceptum Domini Dei, de Niniuitis ad resipiscentiam exhortan-dis,compleCtitur. Vt autem alibi in gene-re,de obseruatione legis suæ Deus loquens,ait: Quicquid ego præcipio uobis, custodietis ut facietis: nō addes ad illud, nec diminues ex eo: Deut:12.32. ita hæc in specie de concione pœnitentiæ præci-piens: Prædica, inquit, in ea prædicatio-nem quam loquor ad te. Vult enim De-us præscriptum suum religiosè obseruari à seruis, legatione ipsius nomine de-fungentibus.
main_text.head: THESIS.
main_text.p: Dei solius est, locum, tempus, doctrinæ genus, docendi & agendi modum & rationem seruis suis præscribere.

Vt enim Principis est, Legato manda-Simile ta certa & definita suis quibusdam circum-stantijs, præscribere: nec licet Legato ὑπὲρ τὰ ἰονα μικὰ πνλ[?] ac plura quàm in mandatis accepit, tum dictis tum factis exequi:

page.notes: Greek phrase after "Legato" is hard to read at this resolution; the reading "ὑπὲρ τὰ ἰονα μικὰ πνλ" is doubtful and the word-ending is uncertain. "Deut:12.32." is a printed reference; the numerals are read with some doubt. Marginal "Simile" and the two references at the top right are printed in the margin; the word "exequi:" ends the page with a colon, the continuation is on the next page. Long s is printed as f in several places (e.g. "fuæ", "folius"), transcribed as s. Hyphens at line ends are printed and kept.
